rows.evidence: Q1: Materials and methods <U+2013> two-year (2005, 2006) field experiment at Talat Demiroren research station, Sanliurfa, comparing subsurface and surface drip at six pan-based irrigation levels, three replications. Q2: Results/Table 3/Fig. 1 and Conclusions <U+2013> muskmelon yield measured under SSDI and surface drip; regression with dummy indicator showed no significant overall difference between systems, but surface drip yielded significantly more in 2005 while SSDI yielded significantly more in 2006; SSDI used about 10% less water for the same yield.
rows.notes: Study directly compares SSDI and surface drip yield, with year-dependent and contradictory direction, matching the 'controversial/mixed' claim. Single site, single crop, single clay soil, plot scale. Only yield measurement (one method); no soil-water or crop-water-use mechanism reported for the system difference. No limitations stated; dispersion reported only as letter groupings, p-values and r<U+00B2> of regressions.
